title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Triple-decker dinuclear phthalocyanines of formula [PcLn(μ-Pc)Ln(Pc)] place the two Ln ions about 0.36 nm apart, close enough to probe intramolecular f-f effects on dynamics.
explanation: The review identifies a trilayer Pc class, in which the Pc ligands may be heterocyclic, and states that the Ln-Ln spacing of approximately 0.36 nm makes intramolecular f-f interactions experimentally relevant to dynamic magnetism.
conditions: Heterocyclic Pc variants are included in the stated general formula.
caveats: The 0.36 nm spacing is a class-level statement, not a measured range across all derivatives.
